IncidentBot: :rotating_light: HIGH: GPU pool 'west2-primary' saturated. queue_length=1234 avg_token_latency=320ms autoscaler: FAILED scale_error=quota_exceeded. -- auto-created thread 1937654321
Jamie (oncall): got it, paging Dina and shadowing. Paging: @Dina :phone:
Dina (infra): on it, checking quota/limits now
Sasha (sre): seeing a backlog in west2-primary; failed scale events show 'scale_limit_reached' for nodegroup ng-gpu-w2
Jamie (oncall): incident impact? any 5xxs to clients?
SupportBot: Alerts: 502 spikes for /v1/generate from west2 region, customers affected ~12k requests in last 5m, top: enterprise-prod (cust_id: C-9423)
Emily (product): notifying CS for top customers and status page update. ETA for message: 10m
Dina (infra): quota check: project gpu_quota=100 used=100; autoscaler requested +8 nodes but cloud quota blocks. Opening provider ticket/console now.
Sasha (sre): autoscaler log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T09:10:02Z] autoscaler: request_add 8 -> denied: QuotaExceededError: REGION_GPUS_quota
[2026-03-15T09:10:03Z] autoscaler: fallback to spillover -> routing policy=spillover:on
```
Jamie (oncall): spillover kicked in — is east1 taking load?
Sasha (sre): east1 accepted some traffic but we're seeing higher tail latency for routed requests (95p=2.4s) and a bump in 502s. kv-cache miss rate increased after model-variant mismatch for some requests.
Kumar (oncall-next): looks like east1 capacity limited too. Suggest we enable emergency-burst from dedicated-reserve pool (dedicated-burst-1) to reduce queue quickly.
Dina (infra): enabling emergency-burst now: `redwoodctl pools borrow --from dedicated-burst-1 --to west2-primary --gpus 6 --duration 30m`
Dina (infra): command accepted, provisioning started (approx 120s)
Jamie (oncall): while GPUs come up, reduce ingress to protect tail latency. Sasha, can we throttle non-critical clients?
Sasha (sre): applying per-key soft-quota: `route_control set --region west2 --max-queue 500 --throttle non_enterprise` -> applied
SupportBot: Throttling policy applied. Non-enterprise keys will receive 429 when queue>500. :warning:
Emily (product): CS updated top customers, drafted email, and created status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1937654321
Jamie (oncall): Dina, ETA for borrowed GPUs becoming ready?
Dina (infra): nodes reporting READY in ~70s, kube-scheduler still warming pods. I'll post when pool shows healthy.
Sasha (sre): monitoring queue: 732 -> 410 after throttle + partial spillover. 5xx rate trending down.
IncidentBot: Note: paging successor @Kumar in 5m
Kumar (oncall-next): acknowledged, I'll take over if Jamie needs to step out.
Jamie (oncall): handing off. TL;DR: west2 primary saturated due to cloud quota; autoscaler denied scale requests; enabled emergency-burst from dedicated reserve; applied per-key throttling; spillover to east1 active but degraded; CS notified; monitoring.
Kumar (oncall-next): copy. Next actions: follow quota ticket, coordinate slow rollback when queue <200 for 10m, run postmortem.
Jamie (oncall): adding runbook notes and marking this as MITIGATING if metrics hold. :thumbsup:
SupportBot: Incident page updated and customer emails queued.
Dina (infra): Quota increase request submitted to cloud provider (ticket #INC-7482) link: https://console.cloud/requests/INC-7482
Sasha (sre): action item: add autoscaler guard to prefer dedicated-burst before failing on quota; add alert on 'scale_request_denied'. Owner: Sasha.
Kumar (oncall-next): I'll own the postmortem and coordinate infra + sres + product.
Jamie (oncall): final check: queue=198 avg_token_latency=180ms error_rate=0.8% -> switching to monitoring-only. Closing active pager. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident severity -> P2; status -> mitigating; last_update_ts -> 1937654861
